<?php
/**
 * Enterprise Session Management & API Gateway
 * Handles authentication, rate limiting, and request routing
 */

class SessionStore {
    private array $sessions = [];
    private array $rateLimits = [];
    
    public function createSession(string $userId, array $metadata): string {
        $sessionId = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
        $this->sessions[$sessionId] = [
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'created_at' => time(),
            'expires_at' => time() + 3600,
            'metadata' => $metadata,
            'auth_level' => 0
        ];
        return $sessionId;
    }
    
    public function getSession(string $sessionId): ?array {
        return $this->sessions[$sessionId] ?? null;
    }
    
    public function updateSession(string $sessionId, array $data): void {
        if (isset($this->sessions[$sessionId])) {
            $this->sessions[$sessionId] = array_merge($this->sessions[$sessionId], $data);
        }
    }
    
    public function destroySession(string $sessionId): void {
        unset($this->sessions[$sessionId]);
    }
}

class AuthenticationProvider {
    private array $users;
    private SessionStore $store;
    
    public function __construct(SessionStore $store) {
        $this->store = $store;
        $this->users = [
            'admin' => ['password_hash' => password_hash('admin_secret_2024', PASSWORD_BCRYPT), 'role' => 'administrator'],
            'service-account' => ['password_hash' => password_hash('svc_key_x9f2', PASSWORD_BCRYPT), 'role' => 'service'],
            'analyst' => ['password_hash' => password_hash('analyst_pass', PASSWORD_BCRYPT), 'role' => 'readonly']
        ];
    }
    
    public function authenticate(string $username, string $password): ?string {
        if (!isset($this->users[$username])) {
            return null;
        }
        if (!password_verify($password, $this->users[$username]['password_hash'])) {
            return null;
        }
        $sessionId = $this->store->createSession($username, [
            'role' => $this->users[$username]['role'],
            'ip' => $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '127.0.0.1'
        ]);
        $this->store->updateSession($sessionId, ['auth_level' => 1]);
        return $sessionId;
    }
    
    /**
     * Elevate session to higher auth level via MFA token
     * Returns new auth_level on success, false on failure
     */
    public function elevateSession(string $sessionId, string $mfaToken): int|false {
        $session = $this->store->getSession($sessionId);
        if ($session === null) {
            return false;
        }
        if ($session['expires_at'] < time()) {
            $this->store->destroySession($sessionId);
            return false;
        }
        // Validate MFA token (TOTP-like validation)
        $expectedToken = $this->computeExpectedToken($session['user_id']);
        if ($this->verifyMfaToken($mfaToken, $expectedToken)) {
            $newLevel = min($session['auth_level'] + 1, 3);
            $this->store->updateSession($sessionId, ['auth_level' => $newLevel]);
            return $newLevel;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    private function computeExpectedToken(string $userId): string {
        $secret = getenv('MFA_SECRET');
        if (empty($secret)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('MFA_SECRET environment variable not configured');
        }
        $timeSlice = intdiv(time(), 30);
        return substr(hash_hmac('sha256', $userId . '|' . $timeSlice, $secret), 0, 6);
    }
    
    private function verifyMfaToken(string $provided, string $expected): bool {
        return hash_equals($expected, $provided);
    }
}

class RequestValidator {
    private SessionStore $store;
    private array $endpointPolicies;
    
    public function __construct(SessionStore $store) {
        $this->store = $store;
        $this->endpointPolicies = [
            '/api/data/read' => ['min_auth_level' => 1, 'allowed_roles' => ['administrator', 'readonly', 'service']],
            '/api/data/write' => ['min_auth_level' => 2, 'allowed_roles' => ['administrator', 'service']],
            '/api/admin/users' => ['min_auth_level' => 2, 'allowed_roles' => ['administrator']],
            '/api/admin/config' => ['min_auth_level' => 3, 'allowed_roles' => ['administrator']],
            '/api/public/health' => ['min_auth_level' => 0, 'allowed_roles' => ['*']]
        ];
    }
    
    /**
     * Validate whether a request should be allowed
     * Returns ['allowed' => bool, 'reason' => string]
     */
    public function validateRequest(string $sessionId, string $endpoint, array $params): array {
        // Public endpoints don't need session
        if ($this->isPublicEndpoint($endpoint)) {
            return ['allowed' => true, 'reason' => 'public_endpoint'];
        }
        
        $session = $this->store->getSession($sessionId);
        if ($session === null) {
            return ['allowed' => false, 'reason' => 'invalid_session'];
        }
        
        // Check session expiry
        if ($session['expires_at'] < time()) {
            $this->store->destroySession($sessionId);
            return ['allowed' => false, 'reason' => 'session_expired'];
        }
        
        // Find matching policy
        $policy = $this->findPolicy($endpoint);
        if ($policy === null) {
            return ['allowed' => false, 'reason' => 'no_policy_defined'];
        }
        
        // Check auth level
        if (!$this->checkAuthLevel($session, $policy)) {
            return ['allowed' => false, 'reason' => 'insufficient_auth_level'];
        }
        
        // Check role
        if (!$this->checkRole($session, $policy)) {
            return ['allowed' => false, 'reason' => 'role_not_allowed'];
        }
        
        // Validate request parameters for injection
        if (!$this->validateParams($params)) {
            return ['allowed' => false, 'reason' => 'invalid_parameters'];
        }
        
        return ['allowed' => true, 'reason' => 'authorized'];
    }
    
    private function isPublicEndpoint(string $endpoint): bool {
        $policy = $this->findPolicy($endpoint);
        return $policy !== null && $policy['min_auth_level'] === 0 && in_array('*', $policy['allowed_roles'], true);
    }
    
    private function findPolicy(string $endpoint): ?array {
        // Normalize endpoint path
        $normalized = $this->normalizePath($endpoint);
        return $this->endpointPolicies[$normalized] ?? null;
    }
    
    private function normalizePath(string $path): string {
        // Remove query string
        $path = strtok($path, '?');
        // Remove trailing slash
        $path = rtrim($path, '/');
        // Collapse multiple slashes
        $path = preg_replace('#/+#', '/', $path);
        // Resolve relative segments
        $segments = explode('/', $path);
        $resolved = [];
        foreach ($segments as $seg) {
            if ($seg === '..') {
                array_pop($resolved);
            } elseif ($seg !== '.' && $seg !== '') {
                $resolved[] = $seg;
            }
        }
        return '/' . implode('/', $resolved);
    }
    
    private function checkAuthLevel(array $session, array $policy): bool {
        $sessionLevel = (int)$session['auth_level'];
        $requiredLevel = (int)$policy['min_auth_level'];
        
        // Enforce maximum auth level cap
        if ($sessionLevel > 3) {
            return false;
        }
        
        return $sessionLevel >= $requiredLevel;
    }
    
    private function checkRole(array $session, array $policy): bool {
        if (in_array('*', $policy['allowed_roles'], true)) {
            return true;
        }
        $userRole = $session['metadata']['role'] ?? '';
        return in_array($userRole, $policy['allowed_roles'], true);
    }
    
    private function validateParams(array $params): bool {
        foreach ($params as $key => $value) {
            if (is_string($value) && preg_match('/[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F]/', $value)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

class ApiGateway {
    private AuthenticationProvider $auth;
    private RequestValidator $validator;
    private SessionStore $store;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->store = new SessionStore();
        $this->auth = new AuthenticationProvider($this->store);
        $this->validator = new RequestValidator($this->store);
    }
    
    public function handleLogin(array $request): array {
        $username = $request['username'] ?? '';
        $password = $request['password'] ?? '';
        
        if (empty($username) || empty($password)) {
            return ['status' => 400, 'error' => 'Missing credentials'];
        }
        
        $sessionId = $this->auth->authenticate($username, $password);
        if ($sessionId === null) {
            return ['status' => 401, 'error' => 'Authentication failed'];
        }
        
        return ['status' => 200, 'session_id' => $sessionId];
    }
    
    public function handleMfaElevation(array $request): array {
        $sessionId = $request['session_id'] ?? '';
        $mfaToken = $request['mfa_token'] ?? '';
        
        if (empty($sessionId) || empty($mfaToken)) {
            return ['status' => 400, 'error' => 'Missing parameters'];
        }
        
        $result = $this->auth->elevateSession($sessionId, $mfaToken);
        if ($result === false) {
            return ['status' => 403, 'error' => 'MFA validation failed'];
        }
        
        return ['status' => 200, 'auth_level' => $result];
    }
    
    /**
     * Main request handler - processes API requests
     */
    public function handleApiRequest(array $request): array {
        $sessionId = $request['session_id'] ?? '';
        $endpoint = $request['endpoint'] ?? '';
        $params = $request['params'] ?? [];
        
        $validation = $this->validator->validateRequest($sessionId, $endpoint, $params);
        
        if (!$validation['allowed']) {
            return ['status' => 403, 'error' => $validation['reason']];
        }
        
        // Process the request
        return $this->routeRequest($sessionId, $endpoint, $params);
    }
    
    private function routeRequest(string $sessionId, string $endpoint, array $params): array {
        $session = $this->store->getSession($sessionId);
        
        switch ($endpoint) {
            case '/api/data/read':
                return ['status' => 200, 'data' => ['items' => []]];
            case '/api/data/write':
                return ['status' => 200, 'message' => 'Data written'];
            case '/api/admin/users':
                return ['status' => 200, 'users' => array_keys($this->getUsers())];
            case '/api/admin/config':
                return $this->handleConfigEndpoint($session, $params);
            default:
                return ['status' => 404, 'error' => 'Not found'];
        }
    }
    
    private function handleConfigEndpoint(?array $session, array $params): array {
        $action = $params['action'] ?? 'read';
        if ($action === 'read') {
            return ['status' => 200, 'config' => ['maintenance_mode' => false]];
        }
        return ['status' => 200, 'message' => 'Config updated'];
    }
    
    private function getUsers(): array {
        return ['admin' => true, 'service-account' => true, 'analyst' => true];
    }
}

/**
 * Rate limiter with sliding window
 */
class RateLimiter {
    private array $windows = [];
    private int $maxRequests;
    private int $windowSize;
    
    public function __construct(int $maxRequests = 100, int $windowSize = 60) {
        $this->maxRequests = $maxRequests;
        $this->windowSize = $windowSize;
    }
    
    public function isAllowed(string $identifier): bool {
        $now = time();
        $windowKey = $identifier;
        
        if (!isset($this->windows[$windowKey])) {
            $this->windows[$windowKey] = [];
        }
        
        // Clean old entries
        $this->windows[$windowKey] = array_filter(
            $this->windows[$windowKey],
            fn($ts) => $ts > ($now - $this->windowSize)
        );
        
        if (count($this->windows[$windowKey]) >= $this->maxRequests) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $this->windows[$windowKey][] = $now;
        return true;
    }
}
